images.title: Six jugs multiplied and a can shared into eight
images.purpose: Show multiplying a capacity (6 jugs of 1 l 250 ml make 7 l 500 ml) and sharing a capacity equally (9 l 600 ml into 8 cans is 1 l 200 ml each).
images.composition: A top panel of six jugs with the working, and a bottom panel of one big can joined to eight equal small cans.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TOP PANEL, y 60 to 330: SIX JUGS in one row, each an upright rounded rectangle 130 by 150 px filled pale teal #CCE5F2 with a 4 px dark #1F2937 outline, left edges at x 110, 325, 540, 755, 970, 1185 and y 90 to 240, each holding the text 1 l 250 ml (28 px, bold, dark). Under the row, centred at x 728, y 300: the text 6 × 1 = 6 l and 6 × 250 = 1,500 ml, so 7 l 500 ml (40 px, bold, dark). DIVIDER: a thin grey #6B7280 horizontal line 3 px at y 370 from x 60 to x 1396. BOTTOM PANEL, y 400 to 770: one big can, a rounded rectangle 360 by 110 px at x 548 to 908, y 410 to 520 filled pale amber #FBE7C0 with a 4 px dark outline, holding the text 9 l 600 ml (44 px, bold, dark). Below it EIGHT SMALL CANS in one row, each a rounded rectangle 140 by 90 px filled amber #E69F00 with a 3 px dark outline, left edges at x 90, 250, 410, 570, 730, 890, 1050, 1210, y 580 to 670, each holding the text 1 l 200 ml (24 px, bold, dark). Eight thin grey 3 px lines join the big can to the eight small cans. Under the row, centred at x 728, y 730: the text 9,600 ÷ 8 = 1,200 ml (44 px, bold, teal #0072B2). Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any count of jugs that differs from 6 or small cans from 8
any capacity other than 1 l 250 ml, 9 l 600 ml and 1 l 200 ml
images.takeaway: To multiply a capacity, multiply the l and the ml and exchange 1,000 ml for 1 l; to share, change to ml and divide.
images.description: Six jugs of 1 l 250 ml making 7 l 500 ml, and a can of 9 l 600 ml shared into eight cans of 1 l 200 ml.
images.context: Concept image for Multiplying and Dividing Capacities. It follows the idea of working with capacities in l and ml in your maths book and shows the concept's own examples (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Count the jugs and the cans with the student. The slip to watch: multiplying only the litres.

image_decisions.why: Equal jugs and equal cans show the multiplication and the sharing.
